description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values for different layers, with a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and ranges from -1 to 21 with linear spacing and tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 with linear spacing and tick labels at 0.2 intervals. There are three lines in the plot: a blue dashed line representing the “sparsity ratio before gate,” which starts at approximately 0.02 at x = -1 and remains steady around 0.01 until x = 21; an orange dotted line representing the “sparsity ratio after gate,” which begins at approximately 0.83 at x = -1, declines steeply to approximately 0.14 at x = 1, and then fluctuates between roughly 0.08 and 0.18 until x = 21; and a green dashed line representing the “sparsity ratio after average gate,” which starts at approximately 0.31 at x = -1, declines to approximately 0.11 at x = 1 and continues to decrease, leveling off around 0.07 from x = 10 to x = 21.
